scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env test
scripts.db:migrate:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env test
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run validate:environments && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production
scripts.deploy:dry:test: npm run validate:environments && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env test
scripts.deploy:test: npm run validate:environments && wrangler deploy --env test
scripts.deploy:production: npm run validate:environments && wrangler deploy --env production
